thread.title: Tech sector hits record as Google parent sees best session since Oct. 2015

author: morningstar.com
title: Tech sector hits record as Google parent sees best session since Oct. 2015
text:
The technology sector hit a record high in early trading on Tuesday, supported by a better-than-expected quarterly earnings report from Alphabet, the parent company of Google. The sector rose 1.2%, extending its year-to-date advance to 17.5%. Alphabet (GOOGL) climbed 4.8%, on track for its biggest one-day percentage gain since October 2015. The search giant hit a record of its own, supported by results that came in much stronger than had been anticipated (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/alphabets-bets-promise-more-growth-ahead-analysts-applaud-tech-giants-results-2018-07-24). The stock is up more than 20% thus far this year. Among other notable technology names, Facebook Inc. (FB) jumped 2.1% and hit an all-time high, while Apple Inc. (AAPL) was up 0.8%. The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 0.5% while the S&P 500 was up 0.7%. The Nasdaq Composite Index climbed 1.1% and hit record levels. The Nasdaq 100 jumped 1.3% and hit record levels.
